integrity: The proof, prior-work implications, and verification limits are stated explicitly; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The 2025 general distance-two characterization is a strong precursor; originality concerns the exact multipartite enumeration and maximal-set classification.
Finite exhaustive verification through order 9 corroborates but does not replace the all-orders proof.
title: Total visibility polynomials of complete multipartite graphs
